notes: v2.124 (2026-11-21, evening run): 123rd tower 'Mistletoe' (green sprig over yellow berries, a blue bow and a red ribbon — a hanging-mistletoe silhouette to demolish, 27 blocks, 4 clusters sizes 11/3/8/5, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) + 120th co-play prompt (hang pretend mistletoe up high, stand under it and hug saying 'hug… hug!', then hug a soft toy — any hug counts; pretend only, real mistletoe out of reach, and nobody has to hug — Liam picks who gets a hug). Hug/affection research: toddlers begin showing affection around age 2 through hugs and holding hands; a hug is also a self-soothing tool (hug a teddy when upset); affection games are choice-based turn-taking — the child picks who gets a hug, never forced.
